text:
mira: :rotating_light: incident-bot didn't page for a critical alert (A-8243), noticed ~19:02 UTC. paging integration seems to be returning 502s
incident-bot: ERROR: failed to deliver page -> 502 from pager-gw; queued retry 1
mira: logs show webhook 502 from pager-integration. anyone on-call?
alex: @mira i'm oncall. can you add short customer impact? need to decide manual page
sam: seeing spike of latency alerts from prod clusters, correlated with deploy ~18:58
mira: impact: support ticket INC-1234, several tenants seeing delayed chat responses, partial outage not global
alex: ok i'll page ops manually. @ops-bot please run runbook: paging-integration-fallback
ops-bot: runbook triggered: paging-integration-fallback. steps: 1) check pager-service status 2) flip fallback flag 3) manual page temp
mira: tried curl to pager endpoint -> 502 and HTML error page. snippet: ```POST /webhook/pager -> 502 Bad Gateway (pager-gw)```
pagerbot: pager delivery failing for all channels, upstream pager-gw returning 502. fallback not auto-enabled (config enable_fallback=false)
sam: that config was changed in the last deploy (PR #5423). looks like the culprit. @alex can you flip the flag or rollback?
alex: flipping prod config: enable_fallback=true via prod-config (starting).. will wait ~30s
ops-bot: config change applied (prod-config v2026-03-18-189). verifying services...
mira: still seeing 502s on curl, but incident-bot retries and manual pages now go through
incident-bot: manual page delivered to oncall (alex) via SMS :phone:
sam: recommend rollback of PR #5423 touching pager integration, low-risk revert?
alex: initiating canary rollback on pager-integration service. monitoring logs for 2m
mira: customer impact update: 7 tenants affected, support is escalating, no confirmed revenue loss but API errors thrown by some clients
ops-bot: post-incident todo: make fallback default, add alert when pager webhook 5xx > 5/min, add runbook step to force manual pager if webhook 5xx persists
alex: pages restored, severity P2. closing live triage; moving to postmortem and follow-up tickets
sam: add unit/integration test to incident-bot to surface webhook 5xx and not silently swallow errors (it was silenced)
mira: i'll file timeline + retro, update support thread and INC-1234. thanks everyone for quick turnaround
